services.desc: Apex Balloons is one of the most personal, dynamic, exciting and experienced hot air balloon companies in the country. We have been providing safe, enjoyable hot air balloon flights in various regions of the United States for nearly 25 years. We offer hot air balloon flights in the Phoenix & Scottsdale Arizona area with the same passionate commitment to service that our guests have come to expect. We schedule and fly hot air balloon rides in Arizona seven days a week year-round, with balloon flights launching daily at sunrise, weather permitting.
